candidates.fresh_evidence: The Food Standards Agency records Greggs at Unit 2 with an inspection on 19 March 2026 and independently records Food Warehouse at Unit 1A; the older 2023 secondary inspection is retained as a temporal caution.

candidates.fresh_evidence: The Food Standards Agency records Umrah Supermarket at Unit 9 with an inspection on 12 May 2026; Leicester City Council's public service record independently identifies Pets at Home at Unit 6 and the retail-park parking area in December 2025.
